name: law_firm_software_008_billing_realization_utilization_report
instruction: Build the fee-earner realization report for the firm, batched under the episode batch code (ops_meta), following the firm's KPI definitions in firm_policies (KPI-REAL-01). Group the firm's recorded work by whoever performed it -- derive the population from the data, not from any fixed roster -- and report per person plus a firm-wide rollup under report='realization'. The policy defines the realization basis (which entry statuses count as billed, how written-off work is treated, and the zero-activity guard). Then, using the rows this batch produced, flag every person whose realization falls more than the episode row's realization_flag_gap percentage points below the firm-wide rate: one ops_reports row per flagged person (report='realization_flag', batch_code) carrying their own rate, the firm rate, and the gap. No other 'realization' or 'realization_flag' rows for this batch may exist. Do not modify any source collection. Every collection this task doesn't write to must remain untouched.

hazards.mechanism: written_off entries are priced at their full amount in the ledger (planted class, snapshot-confirmed: 5971 written_off entries); KPI-REAL-01 counts them in the denominator at full value -- an agent that excludes written-off work computes a different, plausible firm realization rate and misflags the flag set.
one roster employee (EMP-004) books only zero-rate, non-billable entries -- the division guard in KPI-REAL-01 (0.0 when no amount exists) decides their row; a naive percentage blows up or drops them.
the flag threshold is an episode knob (10-20 points below the firm rollup); the flag set moves with it, so memorized flag lists go stale every episode.

success_criteria.summary: One realization row per employee_id appearing in time_entries plus the FIRM rollup, every rate computed on the KPI-REAL-01 basis (billed = approved+invoiced over all entries by amount, written_off in the denominator at full amount, 0.0 guard for no-amount employees); realization_flag rows exactly the set more than realization_flag_gap points below the firm rate, derived from this batch's own rows. Dual-path confirmed (raw-row vs SQL).

checks.expect: per-employee and firm aggregates agree between Python filter and SQL GROUP BY
realization rows + rollup + flag rows exact vs policy-derived expectations

domain_searches.query: law firm realization rate billed vs collected definition

uniqueness_searches.query: fee earner realization report benchmark task write-off denominator agent

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: The difficulty is the policy-chosen denominator basis (written_off at full value) plus an episode-driven flag threshold -- both move the answer, and the natural instinct (exclude write-offs) produces a confidently wrong firm rate.
